name: La Vid y Barrios (Spain)
description: Blue field with a yellow saltire throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Vid y Barrios (crossed keys and a fleur-de-lis above waves).
history: Municipal flag of La Vid y Barrios; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: La Vid y Barrios arms — crossed keys and fleur-de-lis above waves
